title: Axis Twist
description: Rotate the dot into a short line segment by tapping, letting it slip through angled slits. Release to restore the circle and navigate the arena.
controls: Tap or click to rotate (and score)
Press R or click Restart to reset

title: Chrono Pulse
description: A dot auto‑advances while obstacles scroll. Briefly tap to freeze obstacle motion while the dot keeps moving, letting you slip through tight gaps. Timing the freeze determines how far you get before obstacles resume.
controls: Tap / click to freeze obstacles (hold briefly)
Press R or click Restart to restart

title: Lane Shift
description: A dot auto‑scrolls forward while three parallel lanes scroll past. Tap or press Space to cycle the dot to the next lane and thread through each lane’s moving gaps. Survive as long as possible and earn points for every safe pass.
controls: Tap or press Space to change lane
Press R or click Restart to restart

title: Charge Dash
description: Hold to charge a high‑speed dash that lets you thread through fleeting gaps as the dot moves forward.
controls: Hold Space to charge, release to dash
Press R or click Restart to restart

title: Phase Ripple
description: A dot moves forward automatically; tap or press Space to toggle its phase between two sinusoidal waveforms, each allowing passage through a distinct set of oscillating barriers while blocking the other.
controls: Tap or press Space to toggle phase
Press R or click Restart to reset

title: Dual Pulse
description: Tap to split a dot into two synchronized copies that travel opposite directions. Steer both through mirrored gaps, losing if either collides.
controls: Space to split
Arrow keys to steer
Press R or click Restart

title: Elastic Pulse
description: Tap to stretch the dot horizontally, allowing it to slip through narrow vertical gaps; release to snap back and avoid colliding with side walls.
controls: Hold mouse button (or Space) to stretch
Release to snap back
Press R to restart

title: Magnet Pulse
description: Tap to flip the ball’s magnetic polarity, causing it to be attracted to blue plates and repelled by orange plates. Ride the moving plates, avoid spikes, and survive as long as you can.
controls: Click or press Space to toggle polarity
Press R to restart

title: Momentum Slider
description: Tap to reverse the ball's horizontal velocity while it slides along a narrow corridor; time the reversals to weave through moving vertical barriers that appear in sync with the ball's speed.
controls: Tap / click to reverse direction
R to restart the game

title: Color Switch
description: Tap to change the dot’s hue while colored barriers scroll toward it. Align the dot’s color with each barrier’s matching opening to survive as long as possible.
controls: Click or tap to change dot color
R key to restart

title: Spin Tunnel
description: Control a dot sliding through a rotating tunnel; tap to reverse the spin and line up gaps as they approach. Survive as long as possible and try to beat your high score.
controls: Tap / click to reverse spin
Press R to restart

title: Shape Shift
description: Tap to toggle the player between a square and a circle, each passing through differently shaped gaps; survive as obstacles scroll by by matching your form to the opening.
controls: Tap to toggle shape
R to restart

title: Shadow Switch
description: Tap to toggle between parallel light and shadow layers, each with its own moving barriers. Keep the single dot safe by timing your switches so it never collides in either world.
controls: Tap / click to toggle layers
R to restart after game over

title: Ring Collapse
description: Concentric rings continuously shrink; tap the rotating outer marker to pause its spin and line up with gaps in the inner ring before the next collapse.
controls: Click to pause when marker aligns with inner gap
Press R to restart after game over

title: Mirror Slide
description: A line of light bounces between two walls; tap to reflect it horizontally or vertically, timing reflections to navigate through moving obstacles that appear only on one side.
controls: Click or tap to reflect the light

title: Vector Burst
description: A rotating laser beam shoots outward from the center; tap to change its rotation speed and angle, timing bursts to carve safe corridors through incoming geometric walls.
controls: Tap / Click to change laser direction and speed

title: Pulse Runner
description: Navigate a constantly advancing dot through moving gaps by shrinking or growing its size. Each successful passage extends the timer and speeds up the game.
controls: Arrow Up to grow the dot
Arrow Down to shrink the dot

title: Orbit Dodge
description: Orbit around a planet while dodging incoming asteroids on multiple lanes and collecting fuel orbs to extend your time.
controls: Arrow keys to rotate
Space to boost

title: Gravity Flip
description: Control a ball that flips gravity left or right to roll through a side‑scrolling corridor, collecting tokens while avoiding spikes.
controls: Arrow Left to flip gravity left
Arrow Right to flip gravity right
